finding: No persisted fiscal calendar, fiscal year, or accounting period model; financial year exists only as launch input, JSON snapshots, and declaration text
business_impact: Cannot enforce closed-period posting, controlled reopen, entity overrides, or reliable historical fiscal reporting
recommendation: Add tenant calendar definition plus legal-entity override, immutable fiscal-year periods, and audited close/reopen events; map payroll periods and finance handoffs to a fiscal period
migration_backfill: Backfill periods from tenant country, launch financial_year, payroll dates, and declaration codes; require an ambiguity report before activation
compatibility_risk: High: finance/report behavior changes; introduce read-only shadow mapping first
tests: April-March, calendar-year, overlap, close/reopen, March-paid-April, legacy ambiguity

finding: Leave reservation, consumption, release, and direct admin adjustment perform read-modify-save without locking LeaveBalance
business_impact: Concurrent submissions/approvals can lose updates or over-allocate leave
recommendation: Lock the request and balance with select_for_update inside one atomic service; use F expressions where safe; add an idempotency key per mutation
migration_backfill: No value rewrite until ledger reconciliation identifies drift; backfill idempotency references only for attributable events
compatibility_risk: Medium: serialization may expose existing duplicate approvals
tests: Two concurrent submissions, two approvals, cancellation race, admin adjustment race, rollback

finding: LeaveBalanceTransaction records only adjustments/encashment; accrual, reservation, consumption, carry-forward, expiry, forfeiture, cancellation, and reversal overwrite mutable summary columns
business_impact: Historical balances cannot be reconstructed; year-end reruns and expiry corrections are unsafe
recommendation: Expand the ledger action taxonomy and make immutable transactions authoritative; retain LeaveBalance as a locked projection
migration_backfill: Generate a reconciliation report first; synthesize opening transactions only with provenance and approval
compatibility_risk: High: existing balances may not reconcile exactly
tests: Ledger reconstruction, carry-forward rerun, expiry lot, reversal, cancellation restoration

finding: No persisted leave-year period, close run, carry-forward lot, expiry date, or idempotent year-end job
business_impact: Carry-forward can be recomputed from mutable prior balances and cannot support partial expiry or controlled rerun
recommendation: Add LeavePolicyPeriod, LeaveYearCloseRun, and dated ledger lots using the existing policy and background-job patterns
migration_backfill: Backfill policy periods from config snapshots and balance period_year; never merge ambiguous balances automatically
tests: Close/retry/reversal, expiry while leave consumed, policy version change, tenant isolation

finding: Workflow action resolution is neither atomic nor row-locked and has no action idempotency key
business_impact: Concurrent approvers can create duplicate/conflicting logs and invoke downstream leave/attendance effects twice
recommendation: Lock WorkflowInstance/current WorkflowStepInstance, validate transition, and enforce unique action command keys
migration_backfill: Preserve action logs; flag duplicate terminal actions rather than deleting them
tests: Simultaneous approve/reject, duplicate request replay, stale step action

finding: Locked/published immutability is implemented in model clean/save and can be bypassed by QuerySet.update, bulk operations, raw SQL, or a future service
business_impact: Approved payroll, payslips, or finance handoff evidence could silently change
recommendation: Add database check constraints for terminal-state timestamps and service-level write barriers; consider PostgreSQL triggers or append-only permissions for published financial rows
migration_backfill: Validate hashes and snapshots before enabling stronger guards; quarantine mismatches
compatibility_risk: High if existing rows violate terminal invariants
tests: Bypass attempts, terminal transition matrix, hash verification, privileged repair audit

finding: PayrollRun is unique only by tenant/code; no database rule prevents duplicate active runs for the same period/pay group
business_impact: Employees can be paid twice for one payroll scope
recommendation: Add conditional unique active-run constraint on tenant, period, normalized pay-group scope, and run kind; explicitly model off-cycle/supplemental runs
migration_backfill: Classify legacy runs as regular/off-cycle before applying constraint
compatibility_risk: High: ambiguous historic duplicate runs require manual disposition
tests: Regular duplicate, off-cycle allowed, concurrent create, archived/cancelled replacement

finding: Finance handoff has provider period-closed responses but no internal accounting-period mapping or closed-period posting gate
business_impact: A locally accepted handoff may target a closed or wrong fiscal period; reversals lack controlled period semantics
recommendation: Map each handoff/journal to persisted accounting period; require open period; post corrections as linked reversal entries
migration_backfill: Backfill from pay_date/transmitted_at with exception report
tests: Closed posting, reopen authorization, reversal in next open period, provider mismatch

finding: Many tenant-owned rows carry both tenant and foreign keys but cross-tenant consistency is enforced only by model clean or service filtering
business_impact: Bulk/update/raw paths can persist cross-tenant relationships and later leak or corrupt data
recommendation: Use tenant-derived ownership where possible; add composite candidate keys/FKs or PostgreSQL constraint triggers for critical relations; centralize tenant-scoped repositories
migration_backfill: Run read-only cross-tenant orphan audit before constraints
compatibility_risk: Medium-high; composite keys affect migrations and ORM
tests: Cross-tenant insert through ORM bulk/raw, API denial, restore validation

finding: Tenant/employee/policy ownership frequently uses CASCADE and no concrete model adopts SoftDeleteModel
business_impact: Administrative deletion can erase payroll, leave, document, workflow, and audit history
recommendation: Prohibit physical deletion after business activity; use status/archival and legal retention; use PROTECT for financial/history roots and a separately authorized purge process
migration_backfill: Inventory delete endpoints and existing orphaned files; no automatic historical deletion
tests: Delete tenant/employee with history, legal hold, retention expiry, backup restore

finding: A request is charged to the start-date policy period and requests ending after policy expiry are rejected; cross-year allocation is not represented
business_impact: Legitimate leave spanning year boundaries cannot be allocated accurately
recommendation: Split request into persisted dated allocation segments linked to one request and consume each period/lot independently
migration_backfill: No backfill for rejected requests; segment existing crossing requests if any after review
tests: Dec31-Jan2, Mar31-Apr2, mixed holidays, cancellation

finding: Carry-forward has a cap but no expiry, consumption-order, forfeiture, or reversal model
business_impact: Cannot implement expiring carry-forward or prove which units were consumed
recommendation: Create dated entitlement lots with source transaction, expiry date, and FIFO/earliest-expiry allocation
migration_backfill: Backfill one non-expiring lot per current balance only when provenance is unavailable
tests: 10 carried of 18, four expire in 90 days, leave during window, reversal

finding: Proration modes are none/by_join_month; exit-date, daily, transfer, and anniversary cycles are absent
business_impact: Entitlements can be wrong for joiners, leavers, transfers, and anniversary policies
recommendation: Version proration strategies and persist period boundaries/results in ledger metadata
migration_backfill: Keep existing policy behavior as v1 compatibility mode
tests: Join/exit mid-month, leap year, transfer, anniversary rollover

finding: Leave/attendance assignments now have effective dates and race-safe exact-scope/equal-priority PostgreSQL guards; business-date resolution uses canonical employment scope where classified
business_impact: Managed rows resolve historically; legacy NULL ranges remain deliberately unclassified
recommendation: Classify legacy assignments with approved evidence and implement the governed retroactive-correction workflow
migration_backfill: No automatic backfill; use the DB-5 read-only classification report
tests: Historical lookup, mid-period change, equal priority, retroactive correction

finding: Persisted tenant/legal-entity attendance close versions now enforce reconcile-submit-approve-close-reopen transitions; immutable events and PostgreSQL late-write guards preserve closed evidence; payroll input snapshots reference the matching closed version
business_impact: Closed attendance evidence cannot drift silently and payroll input provenance is explicit
recommendation: Keep post-lock corrections governed through reopen/new version and existing payroll adjustment controls; approve any future automatic retro-pay policy separately
migration_backfill: No historical close is inferred; existing payroll snapshots remain nullable and unchanged
compatibility_risk: Low for new managed closes; historical rows remain intentionally unclassified
tests: Correction before/after close, stale reconciliation, reopen, payroll reference, cross-tenant scope

finding: EmploymentSpell and EmploymentAssignment now provide a canonical effective-dated timeline; completed movements create linked versions and Employee remains the current projection
business_impact: Classified/new employees retain historical manager and organization state; ambiguous legacy employees remain on an explicitly labeled fallback
recommendation: Complete approved classification and retroactive-correction administration
migration_backfill: No automatic backfill; classify trustworthy movement history and mark gaps unknown
tests: Backdated transfer, manager history, overlapping assignments, correction

finding: EmploymentSpell supports multiple service periods while stable Employee identity is retained; EmployeeExit remains OneToOne and rehire orchestration is not approved
business_impact: The schema can preserve spells, but exit/rehire continuity and statutory/leave policy cannot yet complete safely
recommendation: Approve rehire continuity rules, link exits to spells, and replace the OneToOne operational limitation additively
migration_backfill: Do not infer prior spells or continuity from mutable current rows
tests: Rehire same entity, new entity, service continuity, duplicate employee code

finding: Cross-entity completed movement now fails atomically before mutation until leave, payroll, statutory, fiscal-calendar, and continuity decisions are recorded
business_impact: Partial cross-entity mutation is prevented, but the supported transition remains unavailable
recommendation: Approve preserve/convert/encash/forfeit, tenure, statutory and fiscal transition rules before implementing orchestration
migration_backfill: Read-only classification only; no dependent assignment rewrite
tests: Transfer mid-pay-period, leave preservation, state PT change, failed partial transfer

finding: PostgreSQL advisory-lock overlap guards now protect active employee salary, pay-group and statutory assignments; other effective-dated versions, slabs and packs retain existing validation
business_impact: Concurrent employee assignment ambiguity is prevented; remaining configuration classes still require measured guards
recommendation: Extend preflight and race-safe constraints to demonstrated overlapping version/slab/pack keys
migration_backfill: Resolve any reported overlaps manually before each staged constraint
tests: Concurrent activation, open-ended range, boundary adjacency

finding: Payroll financial year is inferred from free-form config/declaration code rather than a foreign key to a fiscal year
business_impact: Tax annualization and reports may disagree across runs or malformed codes
recommendation: Reference persisted FiscalYear/TaxYear and snapshot its identity/boundaries into calculations
migration_backfill: Map known FY codes; quarantine malformed or conflicting codes
tests: March payroll paid April, tax-year mapping, code normalization

finding: No explicit payment batch/employee payment instruction ledger exists; finance handoff artifacts cover transmission but not payment lifecycle
business_impact: Cannot independently reconcile payment initiation, bank acceptance, rejection, reissue, and employee settlement
recommendation: Add payment batch and immutable payment instruction/status-event models linked to output artifacts and provider deliveries
migration_backfill: Backfill only identifiable bank-advice deliveries
tests: Partial bank rejection, reissue, duplicate payout, cancellation

finding: Organization hierarchy and scope links do not validate tenant equality or cycles at the database level
business_impact: Cross-tenant parents/entities and hierarchy cycles can corrupt policy resolution and reporting
recommendation: Add service validation plus DB tenant guards; prevent self/cyclic parent chains
migration_backfill: Audit parent graphs and cross-tenant references first
tests: Cycle, self-parent, cross-tenant branch/entity, inactive parent

finding: TenantConfiguration keeps one current/published row; overrides have effective_from but no effective_to/version history
business_impact: Historical configuration resolution may depend on audit JSON rather than a queryable version
recommendation: Add immutable configuration versions and effective ranges while retaining definition/current projection
migration_backfill: Backfill current published version and change-log evidence where complete
tests: Retroactive config, future activation, legal-entity override history

finding: Workflow actor resolution uses identifiers and mutable role/membership links; assignment snapshots do not persist permission/scope evidence
business_impact: Historical proof of why an approver was authorized can be incomplete
recommendation: Snapshot resolved actor, role, permission, scope, and delegation evidence on assignment/action
migration_backfill: Backfill from action logs where attributable; mark unknown otherwise
tests: Role revoked during approval, delegation, historical audit

finding: Only 8 of 111 core models declare explicit Meta indexes; many period/status/tenant workloads rely on FK or incidental indexes
business_impact: 5-10 year ledgers and reports may degrade and increase lock duration
recommendation: Add measured composite/partial indexes for tenant+period/status/effective dates; validate with pg_stat_statements and EXPLAIN
migration_backfill: Concurrent index creation; remove only proven redundant indexes
tests: Query-plan regression at 1M/10M rows, write overhead

finding: Retention refs exist for payroll artifacts but no domain-wide archival/partition lifecycle is implemented
business_impact: Database/object storage growth and legal retention cannot be managed consistently
recommendation: Define per-domain retention/legal hold and partition high-volume event/attendance/payroll tables by date/tenant where measured
migration_backfill: Inventory age/volume; archive with checksum and restore rehearsal
tests: Archive/read, legal hold, restore, tenant export

finding: Tenant timezones exist, but DateTime fields depend on service discipline and mixed local-date calculations
business_impact: DST and cross-timezone cutoff behavior may differ by service
recommendation: Document UTC storage and tenant/calendar timezone conversion boundaries; centralize cutoff helpers
migration_backfill: No data rewrite unless audit finds naive timestamps
tests: DST overnight shift, midnight approval, pay cutoff

finding: Core models declare no CheckConstraint except one unique constraint model; status/timestamp, nonnegative amounts, and date ordering rely on full_clean
evidence: Django metadata audit: 111 core models, one model with Meta.constraints, zero CheckConstraint declarations
business_impact: Bulk/import paths can persist structurally invalid rows
recommendation: Add staged NOT VALID then validated check constraints for critical dates, decimals, counts, and terminal timestamps
migration_backfill: Preflight violations and remediate explicitly
tests: Bulk bypass, invalid date range, negative amounts, terminal timestamps
